item.description: * CueNow now uses macOS's system-managed menu bar integration, keeping its custom menu-bar icon while displaying the CueNow app icon in System Settings > Menu Bar. * Fixed menu bar visibility so CueNow has one independent system control; changing another app's setting no longer affects CueNow. * Existing installs remove only obsolete manual menu-bar metadata. Your notes and regular settings are preserved.

- Fixed CueNow's menu bar icon disappearing when ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude, or another application's menu bar setting was changed. - CueNow now uses its own clean macOS menu bar identity, so each application's visibility switch affects only that application. - Existing CueNow settings are migrated automatically while the corrupted menu bar state is left behind. Notes remain safely stored in Application Support. - Improved the update transition for existing 1.4.51 installations and fresh installs.
